items.source: executorTask - the Runnable to schedule
items.translation: executorTask - 要调度的 Runnable

items.source: delay - the delay before starting the task for the first time (ms)
items.translation: delay - 首次启动任务前的延迟时间（毫秒）

items.source: The ScheduledExecutorService does not offer more sophisticated scheduling options such as cron expressions. Consider using ThreadPoolTaskScheduler for such needs.
items.translation: `ScheduledExecutorService` 不提供诸如 cron 表达式等更高级的调度选项。如需满足此类需求，请考虑使用 `ThreadPoolTaskScheduler`。

items.source: Note that the ScheduledExecutorService mechanism uses a Runnable instance that is shared between repeated executions, in contrast to Quartz which creates a new Job instance for each execution.
items.translation: 请注意，ScheduledExecutorService 机制使用一个在重复执行之间共享的 Runnable 实例，而 Quartz 则为每次执行创建一个新的 Job 实例。

items.source: Note: A period of 0 (for example as fixed delay) is not supported, simply because java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService itself does not support it. Hence a value of 0 will be treated as one-time execution; however, that value should never be specified explicitly in the first place!
items.translation: 注意：不支持周期为 0（例如作为固定延迟），因为 java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService 本身就不支持它。因此，值为 0 将被视为一次性执行；然而，该值从一开始就不应显式指定！

items.source:
Default is -1, leading to one-time execution. In case of a positive value,
the task will be executed repeatedly, with the given interval in-between executions.
items.translation: 默认为 -1，导致任务仅执行一次。如果为正数，则任务将重复执行，每次执行之间的间隔为给定值。

items.source:
Note that the semantics of the period value vary between fixed-rate and
fixed-delay execution.
items.translation: 注意，周期值的语义在固定速率和固定延迟执行之间有所不同。

items.source: See ScheduledExecutorService javadoc for details on those execution modes.
items.translation: 有关这些执行模式的详细信息，请参阅 ScheduledExecutorService 的 Javadoc。

items.source: Specify the time unit for the delay and period values. Default is milliseconds (TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS).
items.translation: 指定延迟和周期值的时间单位。默认为毫秒（TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS）。
